boundary.title: Something went wrong
boundary.body: This page hit an unexpected problem. Try again, or go back to the home page.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to this page
forbidden.body: This page belongs to a different role. Your own tools are on your dashboard.

network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

codes.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed sign-in attempts. Please try again later.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
codes.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email already exists.
codes.ROLL_NO_TAKEN: This roll number is already in use.
codes.EMPLOYEE_CODE_TAKEN: This employee code is already in use.
codes.CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_SELF: You cannot deactivate your own account.
codes.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do that.
codes.NOT_FOUND: That record could not be found.
codes.ENROLLMENT_WINDOW_CLOSED: Enrollment for one of these courses is not open right now.
codes.DUPLICATE_ENROLLMENT: You already have an active application for this training cycle.
codes.TOO_MANY_PREFERENCES: You chose more courses than allowed.
codes.ENROLLMENT_NOT_EDITABLE: This application can no longer be changed.
codes.INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: One or more applications cannot take this action in their current status. Nothing was changed.
codes.CONCURRENT_UPDATE: Someone else changed one of these applications. Refresh and try again.
codes.UNKNOWN_COURSE: One of the chosen courses no longer exists.
codes.COURSE_CODE_TAKEN: A course with this code already exists.
codes.CYCLE_NAME_TAKEN: A cycle with this name already exists.
codes.INVALID_DATES: Check the dates: the end must not be before the start.
codes.IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS: This action is still being processed. Please wait a moment.
codes.BATCH_NAME_TAKEN: This course already has a batch with that name in the cycle.
codes.CAPACITY_BELOW_ENROLLED: Capacity cannot be lower than the number of students already in the batch.
codes.COURSE_NOT_PREFERRED: The student did not choose this course.
codes.WRONG_CYCLE: The application is for a different cycle.
codes.NOT_PLACEABLE: Only approved or waitlisted applications can be placed.
codes.ALREADY_PLACED: This student is already in a batch.
codes.BATCH_NOT_PLANNED: Students can only be removed before the batch starts.
codes.NO_TRAINER: Assign at least one trainer before activating.
codes.INVALID_BATCH_STATUS: This batch cannot be activated in its current status.
codes.LAST_TRAINER: An active batch must keep at least one trainer.
codes.PREVIEW_STALE: Applications or batches changed since this preview. Run a new preview.
codes.PREVIEW_EXPIRED: This preview has expired. Run a new preview.
codes.OUTSIDE_BATCH_DATES: Sessions must fall within the batch dates.
codes.TOO_MANY_SESSIONS: That schedule would create too many sessions. Shorten the date range.
codes.INVALID_TIMES: The session must end after it starts.
codes.TRAINER_NOT_ASSIGNED: Assign the trainer to the batch first.
codes.SESSION_NOT_SCHEDULED: Only scheduled sessions can be cancelled.
